dependencies.purpose: PDF page rasterization and text layer

capabilities: portable-runtime AppContainer sandbox for local stdio MCP servers: explicit runtime directory, read/execute ACL grant, Node.js symlink-preservation flags, and a native CI gate with a copied Node runtime and approved tool call
MCP OAuth RFC 8628 device-code flow with user code/verification URI, authorization_pending/slow_down/expired/denied handling, DPAPI tokens and refresh
approval-gated index_pdf_pages: PDFium text-layer batch indexing of up to 25 pages merged into the local content index
approval-gated index_video_frames: optional FFmpeg frame extraction plus Windows OCR of up to 12 timestamped frames into the local content index
no model calls, no source modification and no silent fallback for sandbox or indexing failures
securityBoundaries: MCP sandbox requires ACL-grantable user-writable runtime directories; system-installed runtimes may be refused with an explicit error
all external actions and index writes remain approval-gated; unexpected external outcomes are never replayed
OAuth supports authorization-code + PKCE and device code with dynamic registration; no enterprise SSO in this version
batch indexing is local text only; no visual embeddings, no whole-document/video semantic index, no cloud upload
